title: Dataverse - Dataverse Data Available in Agent Builder Declarative Agents
body:
We are announcing the ability to select Power Platform and Dynamics 365 data as a knowledge data source when creating and editing Declarative Agents built in Agent Builder in Microsoft Dataverse. This feature reached general availability on November 17, 2026. 

How does this affect me?

With this feature, users will be able to build Declarative agents that can target Dataverse data from Model Driven Power Apps and Dynamics 365 sources. This feature enables fast, natural language-based text querying for data across multiple applications at a time, greatly reducing the time needed for users to access critical business data across apps, forms, and views.

This feature is enabled for environments by turning on the Work IQ feature in the Power Platform admin center. For new, production environments that are not part of Government cloud, EU/EFTA, or FedRAMP, this feature is automatically enabled and ready for use. 

 
What action do I need to take?
  
This message is for awareness, and no action is required.
